summary.text: This briefing evaluates the combination of GPT models, natural language queries, and text-to-sql tasks to translate user phrasing into executable database queries. Per dvf:16, the design scores 3.0 on Desirability and 4.0 on Feasibility, while Viability is unassessed due to missing evidence. The approach addresses the limitation where direct generation causes models to mistakenly use wrong relationship roles or aggregation grains.

target_user.text: Enterprise data analysts and developers who interact with structured databases via open-source data assistant packages such as pkg:dbgpt and repositories like repo:eosphoros-ai/db-gpt.

jtbd.text: Translate natural language queries into accurate SQL queries using language models while preventing wrong relationship roles or aggregation grains.

value_prop.text: Allows users to query complex enterprise databases conversationally without needing to manually write SQL or master underlying database schemas.

riskiest_assumption.text: The riskiest assumption is axis V (viability), which was designated due to missing evidence in the bundle per dvf:16. We assume that enterprise customers are willing to pay a recurring subscription fee for a managed text-to-sql translation layer.

mvp.text: Conduct customer interviews and a price acceptance test with enterprise data teams to validate willingness to pay for a managed text-to-sql translation product, referencing the viability gap in dvf:16.
mvp.type: customer interviews and price acceptance test

success_metric.text: Achieve a proposed threshold of 40 percent positive pricing acceptance and intent-to-buy commitments during customer interviews, as motivated by dvf:16.

kill_criteria.text: Fewer than a proposed threshold of 15 percent of interviewed enterprise stakeholders confirm a budget or willingness to pay for the solution, per dvf:16.

open_source.use: Serves as the foundational open-source agentic AI data assistant for building AI and data products.
Provides core package modules for integrating language models with structured database workflows.

to_build.text: Build a commercial pricing dashboard and user feedback collection module to conduct the price acceptance test required by dvf:16.
